title: Enforce Order with Type-State
goal: Ensure a connection can only send data after it is authenticated.

source.attribution: adapted from API Guidelines: Type Safety

hints: Check which state `Connection::send` should require to guarantee authentication.
Follow how `conn` transitions when authenticated in `main`.
explanation: By defining `send` only on `Connection<Authed>`, calling `send` on an unauthenticated `Connection<Raw>` is rejected at compile time with `E0599`. Transitioning from `Raw` to `Authed` consumes `self` and returns `Connection<Authed>`. Calling `authenticate()` twice fails because `authenticate()` is only defined for `Connection<Raw>`. This enforces API safety at zero runtime cost.
